source: source SHA and 16 outputs from WORKERS_AI_DCM_PILOT_20261027_PROTOCOL.json and RAW.json
ordering: 16 candidate findings anonymized and presented in first order then exact reverse; no origin/arm supplied
candidate_unit: one of the 16 numbered findings from four worker runs; repeated claims counted separately for reliability and de-duplicated for content benefit
primary_rule: A finding is actionable only when exact original quote is present or whitespace-only variation, identified misconception/omission persists after checking full original and adjacent paragraphs, and proposed edit adds warranted information rather than repeats existing facts.
strict_rule: Any grader missing case judgments or changing its model is not comparable; contradictory order grades go to manual independent medical review; a model judge is not a clinician
outcome: No published article edit; no PROMOTE LITE without higher supported unique actionable findings, noninferior false positives on independently reviewed heldout articles and owner time evidence
limitations: Study uses one article, same base inference model, prompt order not perfectly balanced, authored failure context known to evaluator, artificial reviewer and no external clinical certification.
